title: WorkPulse CDC attendance_records row v1
description: Captured `attendance_records` columns for the attendance fact — work date, late state, minutes late and duration only. No notes, names or client-supplied free text.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the row belongs to — enforced end-to-end.

employee_id.description: Employee the record belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

workday.description: Calendar date of the record, Debezium epoch-day encoding.

duration_minutes.description: Worked minutes, set at check-out; null while the record is still open.

late.description: Lateness flag set once at check-in and never cleared.

minutes_late.description: Whole minutes past shift start + grace when `late` is true; null when not late. Added to the OLTP row by the rule-5 migration so the projection no longer needs the event payload.
